data\\entities.ini.alpha_wolf|examine.info: The leader of the moor pack: black as night, eyes like coals.

data\\entities.ini.banker|examine.info: A very serious man with a very large ledger.

data\\entities.ini.berries|examine.info: A handful of juicy red berries.
data\\entities.ini.berry_pie|examine.info: A berry pie with a lattice crust.
data\\entities.ini.blacksmith|examine.info: Arms like tree trunks. She works the forge.
data\\entities.ini.blank_scroll|examine.info: A blank sheet of parchment. The wizard can teach you to write spells on it.

data\\entities.ini.bog_myrtle|examine.info: A sprig of bog myrtle. It smells of resin.
data\\entities.ini.bog_troll|examine.info: A troll of the marshes, green with slime.

data\\entities.ini.bronze_helm|examine.info: A bronze helm. It rings when you knock on it.

data\\entities.ini.caravan_ledger|examine.info: Qadir's caravan ledger, half buried in sand.

data\\entities.ini.cave_troll|examine.info: A huge cave troll. Its club is the size of a tree.
data\\entities.ini.chefs_hat|examine.info: A tall white hat. Very professional, and no use at all in a fight.
data\\entities.ini.coal|examine.info: A lump of coal. A smith needs it to make steel.

data\\entities.ini.copper_bar|examine.info: A bar of copper. Soft, but pretty.

data\\entities.ini.cow|examine.info: A big brown and white cow. Moo.
data\\entities.ini.defence_potion|examine.info: An amber potion: +4 Defence for two minutes. Drink it before a fight.
data\\entities.ini.dragon_sword|examine.info: The Dragon Sword, forged in dragonfire: its red blade is warm to the touch.
data\\entities.ini.dragonsbane|examine.info: Dragonsbane: a vial of Morwen's brew, thick and green. Its fumes will sicken a dragon the moment you step into its lair.
data\\entities.ini.dragon|examine.info: Ignaroth, the dragon of Ashpeak: red scales, burning eyes and a hoard to match.
data\\entities.ini.druid|examine.info: The Druid of Thornwick, in robes the colour of moss.
data\\entities.ini.dwarf|examine.info: Brokk Stonebeard, a dwarf miner. His beard reaches his belt.
data\\entities.ini.eel_spot|examine.info: Bubbles rise from the black water. Something pale coils below. Fishing 15.
data\\entities.ini.elder|examine.info: Elder Pike of Fenwick. He looks pale and tired.
data\\entities.ini.emerald_ring|examine.info: A gold ring set with an emerald. Sharp eyes, steady hand.
data\\entities.ini.farmer|examine.info: A farmer, worried about his chickens.
data\\entities.ini.farsight_scroll|examine.info: A scroll of Farsight: lets you see much further through the fog of war for a minute and a half. Magic 8. Right-click it and Cast, or use it on a monster.
data\\entities.ini.ferry_ticket|examine.info: A ticket for the Southport ferry, stamped by the milkmaid. Good for one crossing.
data\\entities.ini.fire_bolt_scroll|examine.info: A scroll of Fire Bolt: hurls a ball of fire at one foe (2-5 damage). Magic 1. Right-click it and Cast, or use it on a monster.

data\\entities.ini.fish_spot|examine.info: Ripples on the water: a shoal of fish feeding near the surface.
data\\entities.ini.fisherman|examine.info: An old fisherman in a yellow oilskin. He smells of the sea.
data\\entities.ini.fishing_rod|examine.info: Use it on water to catch fish.
data\\entities.ini.flour|examine.info: A sack of flour. Bake it into bread.
data\\entities.ini.forgemaster|examine.info: Brann the forgemaster, staring at his cold forge.
data\\entities.ini.frost_lily|examine.info: A frost lily from the frozen lake. Its petals are cold as ice and never wilt. For Morwen.
data\\entities.ini.frost_troll|examine.info: A troll of ice and stone. The cold comes off it in waves.
data\\entities.ini.frost_witch|examine.info: A witch of the high snows. Her breath freezes in the air.
data\\entities.ini.full_vial|examine.info: A vial of something murky. Better not drink it.
data\\entities.ini.furnace|examine.info: A furnace, roaring hot. Smelt ore into bars here.
data\\entities.ini.giant_spider|examine.info: A giant spider, as big as a dog.
data\\entities.ini.goblin_archer|examine.info: A goblin with a short bow and a quiver of crooked arrows.
data\\entities.ini.goblin_shaman|examine.info: A goblin shaman, bones in its hair and fire in its hands.
data\\entities.ini.gold_bar|examine.info: A heavy bar of gold. A jeweller could use this.
data\\entities.ini.gold_ore|examine.info: Gold ore, flecked with yellow. Smelt it into a gold bar.
data\\entities.ini.gold_ring|examine.info: A plain gold ring. It feels lucky.
data\\entities.ini.gravekeeper|examine.info: The Gravekeeper of Ravensgate. He smells faintly of earth.
data\\entities.ini.gravestone|examine.info: Your grave. What you were carrying when you died is buried here.
data\\entities.ini.guard|examine.info: A guard of King Tyron, spear in hand.
data\\entities.ini.healing_scroll|examine.info: A scroll of Healing: heals your wounds (8-14 hitpoints). Magic 2. Right-click it and Cast, or use it on a monster.
data\\entities.ini.herbalist|examine.info: She knows every herb in the Southlands.
data\\entities.ini.herb|examine.info: A fragrant green herb. Used in potions.
data\\entities.ini.hermit|examine.info: A wild-haired hermit. He smells of woodsmoke and moss.

data\\entities.ini.hobgoblin|examine.info: A big, ugly hobgoblin. It looks tougher than a goblin.
data\\entities.ini.hobs_diary|examine.info: Old Hob's diary, swollen with damp.
data\\entities.ini.hob|examine.info: A wild-eyed man in rags, snarling and twitching. There's something familiar about him.
data\\entities.ini.ice_bolt_scroll|examine.info: A scroll of Ice Bolt: a shard of ice that hurts a foe and slows it to half speed for 8 seconds (2-6 damage). Magic 10. Right-click it and Cast, or use it on a monster.
data\\entities.ini.iron_gauntlets|examine.info: Iron gauntlets. A solid grip on your sword.
data\\entities.ini.iron_helm|examine.info: An iron helm with a nose guard.
data\\entities.ini.iron_ore|examine.info: A lump of iron ore. Smelt two into an iron bar at a furnace.
data\\entities.ini.iron_shield|examine.info: A round iron shield with a red cross.
data\\entities.ini.iron_sword|examine.info: A plain iron sword. Heavy and honest.
data\\entities.ini.key|examine.info: An old iron key. The beggar in Ashford lost a key like this.
data\\entities.ini.king_tyron|examine.info: King Tyron, ruler of the Southlands.
data\\entities.ini.leather_body|examine.info: A laced leather jerkin. Light, and better than nothing.
data\\entities.ini.lightning_scroll|examine.info: A scroll of Lightning: a bolt of lightning at one foe (6-14 damage). Magic 20. Right-click it and Cast, or use it on a monster.
data\\entities.ini.logs|examine.info: Ordinary logs. Burn them, or make handles and shields with them.
data\\entities.ini.magic_potion|examine.info: A violet potion: your spells do 5 more damage for two minutes.
data\\entities.ini.meat_pie|examine.info: A meat pie with a golden crust. Heals 7.
data\\entities.ini.mega_potion|examine.info: A brilliant green potion that heals almost any wound (45-55 hitpoints).
data\\entities.ini.merchant|examine.info: Qadir the merchant. His caravan is late.
data\\entities.ini.milkmaid|examine.info: The milkmaid, who looks after the Isle's cows and sheep.
data\\entities.ini.mine_cart|examine.info: An old mine cart, still half full of ore.
data\\entities.ini.miner|examine.info: Old Tom, the last miner in the iron mine.
data\\entities.ini.mithril_axe|examine.info: A mithril axe. Trees practically fall over by themselves.
data\\entities.ini.mithril_bar|examine.info: A bar of mithril. Only a master smith can work it.
data\\entities.ini.mithril_boots|examine.info: Mithril boots. You hardly know you're wearing them.
data\\entities.ini.mithril_ore|examine.info: Mithril ore. It's light as a feather and shimmers blue-green.
data\\entities.ini.mithril_pickaxe|examine.info: A mithril pickaxe, light and keen. The best there is.

data\\entities.ini.mithril_sword|examine.info: A mithril sword. It weighs nothing and cuts like the wind.
data\\entities.ini.oak_bow|examine.info: An oak shortbow. Carry arrows and attack from a distance.

data\\entities.ini.oak_shield|examine.info: A heavy oak shield, rimmed with brass.
data\\entities.ini.oak_staff|examine.info: A knotted oak staff. Spells come easier with it: +2 to their damage.
data\\entities.ini.owl_potion|examine.info: A smoky blue potion that smells of the night: you see far further through the fog for three minutes.
data\\entities.ini.pickaxe|examine.info: An iron pickaxe, for mining rocks.
data\\entities.ini.quartermaster|examine.info: The keep's quartermaster. He counts everything twice.
data\\entities.ini.rabbit|examine.info: A brown rabbit, twitching its nose.
data\\entities.ini.ranger|examine.info: Ranger Ash, keeper of the Wildwood's watch stones.
data\\entities.ini.range|examine.info: A cooking range. Cook raw food on it, or bake.

data\\entities.ini.raw_chicken|examine.info: Raw chicken. Cook it on a fire or a range.

data\\entities.ini.raw_meat|examine.info: Raw meat. Cook it on a fire.

data\\entities.ini.raw_trout|examine.info: A speckled trout. Cook it on a fire or a range (Cooking 10).
data\\entities.ini.ruby_ring|examine.info: A gold ring set with a ruby. It burns with fighting spirit.
data\\entities.ini.salmon_spot|examine.info: A salmon run: silver fish leaping. Fishing 20.
data\\entities.ini.sapphire_ring|examine.info: A gold ring set with a sapphire. It wards off blows.
data\\entities.ini.scorpion|examine.info: A giant desert scorpion. Mind the tail.
data\\entities.ini.shepherd|examine.info: A weather-beaten shepherd. His sheep are fewer than they were.
data\\entities.ini.shopkeeper|examine.info: He runs the Ashford General Store.
data\\entities.ini.silver_bar|examine.info: A bar of shining silver. A jeweller could use this.

data\\entities.ini.silver_ring|examine.info: A silver ring. Your sword arm feels steadier.
data\\entities.ini.silver_tiara|examine.info: A silver circlet. Elegant, and it turns a glancing blow.
data\\entities.ini.skeleton_archer|examine.info: A skeleton with a cracked longbow. Its aim is still good.

data\\entities.ini.stubble|examine.info: Stubble. The wheat will grow again.
data\\entities.ini.super_potion|examine.info: A strong healing potion. Drink it to restore 40 hitpoints.
data\\entities.ini.swordfish_spot|examine.info: A great fin cuts the water. Swordfish! Fishing 35.

data\\entities.ini.willow_staff|examine.info: A willow staff set with a sapphire: +4 spell damage.
data\\entities.ini.witch_brew|examine.info: Morwen's brew for Elder Pike. It bubbles on its own.

data\\entities.ini.wizard|examine.info: The court wizard. His hat is very pointy.
data\\entities.ini.wolf|examine.info: A grey wolf. It looks hungry.
data\\entities.ini.woman|examine.info: The ferrywoman. She smells of salt and tar.
data\\entities.ini.wooden_shield|examine.info: A round wooden shield with an iron boss.
data\\entities.ini.workbench|examine.info: A sturdy workbench for leather, wool and jewellery.
